conditioning_shape.details: Truthful disclosure of source/cohort and later historical conditioning; this is separate AI checking, not external expert or independent-source validation

coverage_shape.actual_pair_ids_viewed: Each exact protocol pair ID once
coverage_shape.actual_target_ids_inspected: Each exact protocol target ID once
coverage_shape.source_board_ids: Actual native paired board IDs viewed

target_observations: Exactly the protocol target IDs once, using target_record_shape and route_element_shape from the frozen source-reader output format. These are current final source facts and may remain unresolved; preserve competing routes, ownership and visibility. Do not copy the historical baseline or its full source map.
pair_reviews: Each exact protocol pair once using pair_record_shape from the source-reader format, including actual_native_board_id, direct coverage, all eight paired source comparisons and native witnesses, significant_variation, remaining_uncertainty and UNKNOWN cipher identity/letter. candidate_outcome uses the same four source-reader outcome enums. Fresh-reader conflicts or missing ownership/visibility gates remain unresolved; no majority vote or prose-only negative.

correction_review_shape.claim_id: Exact historical correction_claims ID; cover every supplied correction claim once
correction_review_shape.grounds: Exact old literal versus positively supported new source fact; distinguish a factual error from merely weaker visibility or another opinion

qualification_review_shape.qualification_id: Exact historical support_qualification_records ID; cover every supplied qualification once
qualification_review_shape.grounds: Whether the precise old support/absence claim is overstated, retracted or still unresolved; a qualification is not automatically a contrary source fact

quarantine_review_shape.pair_id: Exact accepted baseline edge implicated by an explicit historical dependency claim
quarantine_review_shape.claim_id_or_qualification_id: Use key claim_id for a correction or qualification_id for a support qualification
quarantine_review_shape.grounds: Exact dependency on the questioned source fact/support claim and why the existing accepted final evidence does or does not already account for it. No blanket quarantine of all incident or overlapping-clique edges.

empty_lists: correction_reviews, qualification_reviews or quarantine_reviews may be empty when their actual input scope is empty. No target outcome count is prescribed.
limits: A new SAME or graphical difference requires the full paired feature/ownership/visibility gates from both fresh readers and this separate final source audit. Only positive visible topology, enclosure, attachment or terminal-presence incompatibility can support DIFFERENT; unvalidated direction, length or bar-height variation cannot. Preserve initial reports and historical D12 graph. Current graph updates use only gated new SAME edges and exact source-audited quarantines; overlapping cliques remain sets. No new 772 comparison, cipher letter, alphabet partition or reading order is authorized here. Default offline checks verify published bytes and source attestations without opening images/private proofs; they do not mechanically prove physical target binding.
